## What's new

Threadnote 5.2.0-beta.4 makes published Codex Cloud environments recover their managed startup guidance automatically, so each fresh task can restore private memory, structural graphs, and scoped Context Briefs before work begins.

- Codex Cloud startup restores managed guidance and skill files from its saved profile when runtime-scoped files are missing in a fresh task.
- Startup refreshes configured memory shares without committing or pushing local changes, prepares the structural graph, and verifies readiness before work continues.
- The Start skill explains how to preserve the task's `HOME` and `CODEX_HOME`, while unowned-file conflicts remain protected from overwrite.
- The Codex Cloud guide now documents the supported CLI workflow for briefs, graphs, recall, reads, and Knowledge Delta approval.

[Full changelog since 5.2.0-beta.3](https://github.com/threadnote/threadnote/compare/v5.2.0-beta.3...v5.2.0-beta.4)
